senses.en: A coin worth ten cents in the US or Canada.

ex.en: A shiny dime rolled out of my jacket pocket.
ex.zh: 一枚亮闪闪的十分硬币从我的夹克口袋里滚了出来。

ex.en: Although a dime has little purchasing power, small cash donations can collectively support valuable community projects.
ex.zh: 虽然一枚十分硬币购买力有限，但小额现金捐款汇集起来也能支持有益的社区项目。

col: a dime a dozen｜多得不稀奇
not cost a dime｜分文不花
on a dime｜骤然；在极小范围内
tip: 一美元等于十个dime；主要用于美加语境。

senses.en: The activity of eating a meal

ex.en: We moved the dining table closer to the window.
ex.zh: 我们把餐桌挪到了更靠近窗户的地方。

ex.en: Shared dining spaces in student accommodation can encourage social interaction and help newcomers develop a sense of belonging.
ex.zh: 学生宿舍中的公共用餐空间能促进社交互动，帮助新入住者建立归属感。

tip: 也是dine的现在分词；dining只有一个n。

senses.en: a prehistoric reptile, often large, known mainly from fossils
a person or thing considered outdated and resistant to change

ex.en: We saw a huge dinosaur skeleton at the museum.
ex.zh: 我们在博物馆看到了一具巨大的恐龙骨架。

ex.en: Studying dinosaur fossils helps researchers understand how ancient environments differed from those of the present day.
ex.zh: 研究恐龙化石有助于科研人员了解古代环境与当今环境的差异。

tip: 比喻人或机构落伍时带贬义，正式交流慎用。

senses.en: an official document showing successful completion of a course

ex.en: She proudly showed her diploma to her grandparents.
ex.zh: 她自豪地向祖父母展示了自己的毕业文凭。

ex.en: A vocational diploma can provide practical skills that help graduates find employment in specialised industries.
ex.zh: 职业教育文凭课程可以提供实用技能，帮助毕业生在专业行业中找到工作。

col: diploma in nursing｜护理专业文凭
tip: diploma多指毕业或课程文凭，不等同于degree学位。

senses.en: Without anything or anyone coming between.
To guide or control an activity, performance, or group.
To show the way or aim something towards a place.

ex.en: There is a direct train from here to the airport.
ex.zh: 这里有直达机场的火车。

ex.en: Improved public transport can have a direct impact on employment by connecting residents with more job opportunities.
ex.zh: 改善公共交通能让居民获得更多就业机会，从而对就业产生直接影响。

col: direct attention to｜将注意力转向
tip: direct可作形容词或动词；常见读音也有/daɪˈrekt/。

senses.en: Without anyone or anything coming between
Immediately or after a very short time
Exactly in a particular position

ex.en: Please send the photos directly to my phone.
ex.zh: 请把照片直接发到我的手机上。

ex.en: Improved public transport can directly reduce household travel costs and increase access to employment.
ex.zh: 改善公共交通可以直接降低家庭出行成本，并增加就业机会。

tip: directly可指直接，也可指正好在某位置。

senses.en: Unwanted material that makes something unclean
Loose earth, especially on the ground

ex.en: Please wipe the dirt off your shoes before entering.
ex.zh: 进来之前，请把鞋上的泥污擦掉。

ex.en: Regular handwashing removes dirt and reduces the spread of infections in schools and other shared spaces.
ex.zh: 经常洗手可以去除污垢，减少学校及其他公共场所的感染传播。

tip: 通常不可数；表示“泥土”时多见于美式英语。

senses.en: Having a condition that limits activities or participation in society.

ex.en: The pool has a lift for disabled swimmers.
ex.zh: 游泳池设有供残障游泳者使用的升降设备。

ex.en: Universities should provide accessible facilities and appropriate support to ensure that disabled students can participate fully in campus life.
ex.zh: 大学应提供无障碍设施和适当支持，确保残障学生能够充分参与校园生活。

col: disabled parking space｜残障人士专用停车位
tip: 可说disabled people或people with disabilities，尊重本人偏好。

senses.en: something that makes success harder or reduces something's value

ex.en: The main disadvantage of this flat is the noise.
ex.zh: 这套公寓的主要缺点是噪声大。

ex.en: Students without reliable internet access face a significant disadvantage when schools rely heavily on online learning.
ex.zh: 当学校高度依赖线上学习时，无法稳定上网的学生会明显处于不利地位。

col: at a disadvantage｜处于不利地位
tip: 表示处于不利地位用at a disadvantage。

senses.en: To make someone unhappy by failing to meet their expectations.

ex.en: I knew cancelling our picnic would disappoint the children.
ex.zh: 我知道取消野餐会让孩子们失望。

ex.en: Public transport improvements may disappoint commuters if services remain unreliable despite substantial investment in new vehicles.
ex.zh: 尽管大量资金投入了新车辆，若服务仍不可靠，公共交通的改善可能会让通勤者失望。

tip: 人感到失望用disappointed；事物令人失望用disappointing。

senses.en: Unhappy because something was not as good as you hoped.

ex.en: I was disappointed when rain cancelled our beach picnic.
ex.zh: 下雨导致我们的海滩野餐取消，我很失望。

ex.en: Graduates may feel disappointed if their first jobs offer few opportunities to apply the skills they have learned.
ex.zh: 如果第一份工作很少提供运用所学技能的机会，毕业生可能会感到失望。

col: disappointed to hear｜听到……感到失望
tip: disappointed形容人的感受；disappointing形容令人失望的事物。

senses.en: sadness because something was not as good as expected
someone or something that fails to meet your hopes

ex.en: Her face showed disappointment when the picnic was cancelled.
ex.zh: 野餐取消时，她脸上露出了失望的神情。

ex.en: Teaching young people to cope with disappointment can help them respond more positively to academic setbacks.
ex.zh: 教年轻人应对失望，有助于他们更积极地面对学业上的挫折。

col: to my disappointment｜令我失望的是
a bitter disappointment｜极其令人失望的事
tip: 指情绪通常不可数；指令人失望的事可用a disappointment。

senses.en: An event causing great damage, suffering, or loss.
Something that goes extremely badly or fails completely.

ex.en: Dinner was a disaster because I burned the rice.
ex.zh: 晚餐糟透了，因为我把米饭烧焦了。

ex.en: Effective early warning systems can reduce the damage caused by natural disasters and help communities recover more quickly.
ex.zh: 有效的预警系统可以减少自然灾害造成的损失，并帮助社区更快恢复。

tip: 也可夸张形容失败：The party was a disaster。

senses.en: a reduction in the usual price
to sell something at a reduced price
to consider something unlikely or less important

ex.en: The shop offers a discount on winter coats.
ex.zh: 这家店的冬季外套有折扣。

ex.en: Public transport discounts can encourage more commuters to leave their cars at home.
ex.zh: 公共交通票价优惠能鼓励更多通勤者不开车出门。

col: discount the possibility｜不考虑这种可能性
tip: 名词重音在首音节；动词通常读/dɪsˈkaʊnt/。

senses.en: finding something previously unknown, or the thing that is found

ex.en: We made an exciting discovery behind the old cupboard.
ex.zh: 我们在旧橱柜后有了一个令人兴奋的发现。

ex.en: The discovery of new antibiotics could help health services respond more effectively to drug-resistant infections.
ex.zh: 新抗生素的发现有助于医疗机构更有效地应对耐药性感染。

tip: discovery是发现原已存在的事物，不同于invention。

senses.zh: 令人恶心的；令人反感的
senses.en: extremely unpleasant, making you feel sick or strongly dislike something

senses.zh: 令人愤慨的；不可接受的
senses.en: so bad or wrong that it causes strong disapproval

ex.en: A disgusting smell came from the forgotten rubbish bag.
ex.zh: 那个被遗忘的垃圾袋散发出一股令人恶心的气味。

ex.en: Residents described the illegal dumping of waste beside their homes as disgusting and demanded immediate action.
ex.zh: 居民称在住宅旁非法倾倒垃圾的行为令人愤慨，并要求立即采取行动。

col: a disgusting smell｜令人恶心的气味
tip: disgusting形容事物令人反感；disgusted形容人感到反感。

senses.en: a device that stores computer data on a circular surface
a flat, thin, round object

ex.en: My laptop's disk is almost full of holiday photos.
ex.zh: 我的笔记本电脑磁盘里几乎存满了度假照片。

ex.en: Regular backups protect important research data against accidental deletion and unexpected disk failure in university computer systems.
ex.zh: 定期备份可保护重要研究数据，避免其因误删或大学计算机系统的突发磁盘故障而丢失。

tip: 计算机磁盘用disk；英式圆盘、光盘通常写disc。

senses.en: To find someone or something unpleasant or not enjoyable.
A feeling of not liking someone or something.

ex.en: I dislike waiting outside when it is raining.
ex.zh: 我不喜欢下雨时在外面等候。

ex.en: Some students dislike group assignments because they feel that individual contributions are not assessed fairly.
ex.zh: 一些学生不喜欢小组作业，因为他们觉得个人贡献没有得到公平评价。

col: dislike doing something｜不喜欢做某事
a strong dislike of｜对……的强烈反感
take a dislike to｜开始讨厌
tip: dislike后接名词或动名词：dislike waiting。

senses.en: Put something where people can see it
An arrangement of things for people to look at
A screen that shows information or images

ex.en: The bakery displays fresh cakes beside the front window.
ex.zh: 面包店把新鲜蛋糕陈列在前窗旁。

ex.en: Museums increasingly display everyday objects to illustrate how ordinary people lived in the past.
ex.zh: 博物馆越来越多地展示日常物品，以呈现过去普通人的生活方式。

col: a colourful display｜色彩缤纷的陈列
tip: on display意为“在展出”，中间不加冠词。

senses.en: An area defined by its features or official boundaries.

ex.en: We found a small bakery in the old market district.
ex.zh: 我们在老市场区找到了一家小面包店。

ex.en: Improving public transport in suburban districts can reduce car dependence and widen access to employment.
ex.zh: 改善郊区的公共交通可以减少对汽车的依赖，并增加就业机会。

tip: 可指行政划分，也可指具有特定功能的城区。

senses.en: to enter water headfirst or swim beneath its surface
to move downwards suddenly and quickly
an act of diving or a sudden sharp fall

ex.en: We watched a swimmer dive smoothly into the pool.
ex.zh: 我们看着一名游泳者流畅地跃入泳池。

ex.en: Tourists who dive near coral reefs should avoid touching marine organisms to prevent damage to fragile ecosystems.
ex.zh: 在珊瑚礁附近潜水的游客应避免触碰海洋生物，以免破坏脆弱的生态系统。

col: dive into the water｜跃入水中
tip: 过去式英式常用dived，美式也用dove。

senses.en: to separate something into parts or share it among people
to calculate how many times one quantity fits into another
a major difference separating people or groups

ex.en: Let's divide the cake into slices before everyone arrives.
ex.zh: 趁大家还没来，我们先把蛋糕切成小块吧。

ex.en: Unequal access to reliable internet services can deepen the digital divide between urban and rural communities.
ex.zh: 获得可靠互联网服务的机会不均，可能加深城乡社区之间的数字鸿沟。

tip: divide into表示分成；divide by表示除以。

senses.en: the activity of swimming underwater, often using special breathing equipment
the sport of jumping into water, often with controlled movements

ex.en: We went diving and saw colourful fish near the reef.
ex.zh: 我们去潜水，在礁石附近看到了色彩鲜艳的鱼。

ex.en: Diving tourism can support coastal economies, provided operators protect marine habitats and teach visitors responsible behaviour.
ex.zh: 潜水旅游可以促进沿海经济，前提是经营者保护海洋栖息地并教导游客负责任地行动。

tip: go diving 常指去潜水；跳水运动也叫 diving。

senses.en: the legal ending of a marriage
to legally end a marriage
to separate something from something closely connected with it

ex.en: They remained good friends even after their divorce.
ex.zh: 即使离婚后，他们仍是好朋友。

ex.en: Economic growth cannot be divorced from environmental concerns when governments develop policies for sustainable urban expansion.
ex.zh: 政府制定城市可持续扩张政策时，不能将经济增长与环境问题割裂开来。

col: file for divorce｜提出离婚申请
divorce something from something｜将某事与某事分离
tip: divorce sb表示与某人离婚，不加with。

senses.en: Feeling as if you or your surroundings are spinning.

ex.en: I felt dizzy after spinning around with my little cousin.
ex.zh: 和小表弟转了几圈后，我觉得头晕。

ex.en: People who feel dizzy during exercise should stop immediately and seek medical advice if symptoms persist.
ex.zh: 运动时感到头晕的人应立即停下；若症状持续，应咨询医生。

tip: 人作主语用feel dizzy；事物可make人dizzy。

senses.en: A film or programme presenting facts about real subjects.
Consisting of or supported by written documents.

ex.en: We watched a documentary about penguins after dinner.
ex.zh: 晚饭后，我们看了一部关于企鹅的纪录片。

ex.en: A well-researched documentary can raise public awareness of environmental problems without oversimplifying their causes.
ex.zh: 一部经过充分调研的纪录片能够提高公众对环境问题的认识，同时避免过度简化其成因。

col: documentary about wildlife｜关于野生动物的纪录片
tip: 作名词指纪录片；documentary evidence指书面证据。

senses.en: An intelligent aquatic mammal with a long snout and curved fin.

ex.en: A dolphin leapt beside our boat early this morning.
ex.zh: 今天一大早，一只海豚在我们的船边跃出水面。

ex.en: Underwater noise from shipping can disrupt dolphin communication and make it harder for these animals to find food.
ex.zh: 船运产生的水下噪声会干扰海豚交流，使它们更难找到食物。

col: a pod of dolphins｜一群海豚
tip: 海豚是哺乳动物；一群海豚可说a pod of dolphins。

senses.en: To give money, goods, or blood to help others

ex.en: We donate our spare blankets to the local shelter.
ex.zh: 我们把多余的毯子捐给当地的收容所。

ex.en: Businesses can reduce food waste by donating surplus products to charities that support vulnerable families.
ex.zh: 企业可以把剩余食品捐给帮助困难家庭的慈善机构，以减少食物浪费。

col: donate money to charity｜向慈善机构捐款
tip: 用donate something to someone，不用双宾语。

senses.en: a building or shared room where students sleep

ex.en: My dorm is just five minutes from the library.
ex.zh: 我的宿舍离图书馆只有五分钟路程。

ex.en: Living in a dorm can help first-year students develop social skills and adjust to university life.
ex.zh: 住宿舍可以帮助大一学生培养社交技能，适应大学生活。

tip: dorm是dormitory的非正式简称，多见于美式英语。

senses.en: A large room where several people sleep.
A building where students live, especially at American colleges.

ex.en: We shared a dormitory with six other travellers.
ex.zh: 我们和另外六名旅客合住一间集体寝室。

ex.en: Living in a university dormitory can help new students build friendships and adjust to campus life.
ex.zh: 住在大学宿舍可以帮助新生建立友谊，并适应校园生活。

tip: 美式常指学生宿舍楼；英式也常指多人寝室。

senses.en: a small round mark
to appear in scattered places across an area
the spoken name for a full stop in online addresses

ex.en: Her yellow umbrella has a pattern of blue dots.
ex.zh: 她的黄色雨伞上有蓝色圆点图案。

ex.en: Small villages dot the coastline, attracting visitors who prefer quieter alternatives to crowded seaside resorts.
ex.zh: 小村庄散布在海岸线上，吸引了那些偏爱宁静而非拥挤海滨度假区的游客。

tip: on the dot表示准时，常接在具体时刻之后。

senses.en: A feeling of uncertainty about whether something is true or possible.
To feel uncertain about something or think it unlikely.

ex.en: I doubt the shop is still open this late.
ex.zh: 这么晚了，我觉得那家店大概已经关门了。

ex.en: There is little doubt that access to clean water is essential for improving public health.
ex.zh: 毫无疑问，获得清洁用水对于改善公共卫生至关重要。

tip: b不发音；I doubt that常表示认为某事不大可能。

senses.en: A thick mixture of flour and liquid used for baking.
Money, in informal speech.

ex.en: Mina kneaded the dough on a flour-covered kitchen table.
ex.zh: 米娜在撒了面粉的厨房桌子上揉面。

ex.en: Allowing dough to rise slowly can improve bread quality without the need for artificial additives.
ex.zh: 让面团缓慢发酵，无须使用人工添加剂也能改善面包品质。

col: let the dough rise｜让面团发酵膨胀
tip: 不可数名词；稀的面糊通常叫batter。

senses.en: a group of twelve
a large unspecified quantity, used in the plural

ex.en: Please buy a dozen eggs on your way home.
ex.zh: 请在回家的路上买十二个鸡蛋。

ex.en: Dozens of community gardens have opened across the city, giving residents more opportunities to grow food.
ex.zh: 全市已开设数十个社区菜园，让居民有更多机会种植食物。

tip: two dozen不加s；dozens of表示许多。

senses.en: To die, or cause death, by being unable to breathe underwater.
To cover a sound with a much louder sound.

ex.en: She nearly drowned when her boat overturned in the lake.
ex.zh: 她的船在湖里翻了，她差点溺水身亡。

ex.en: Public safety campaigns can reduce the risk of children drowning by encouraging swimming lessons and adult supervision.
ex.zh: 公共安全宣传可以通过鼓励儿童学习游泳和成人看护，降低儿童溺亡风险。

col: drown out a voice｜盖过说话声
drown in paperwork｜陷入文书工作
tip: drown指溺死，不只是落水；盖过声音常加out。

senses.en: A substance used to prevent or treat illness.
A substance taken for its effects on mind or body.
To give someone a substance that makes them unconscious or weak.

ex.en: The doctor prescribed a drug to ease her pain.
ex.zh: 医生开了一种药来缓解她的疼痛。

ex.en: New drug development requires extensive testing to ensure that treatments are both safe and effective.
ex.zh: 新药研发需要进行大量测试，以确保治疗既安全又有效。

tip: 可指治病的药，也可指毒品，须看语境。

senses.en: a musical instrument played by hitting its stretched surface
a large cylindrical container for storing liquids or other materials
to play a drum or tap something repeatedly

ex.en: The little boy beat the drum with both hands.
ex.zh: 小男孩用双手敲鼓。

ex.en: Learning to play the drum can help children develop coordination and participate in group performances.
ex.zh: 学习打鼓能帮助儿童培养协调能力，并参与集体表演。

tip: play the drums常指打鼓；drum也可指大圆桶。

senses.en: A person who plays drums, especially in a musical group.

ex.en: The drummer tapped her sticks together before the song.
ex.zh: 歌曲开始前，女鼓手把两根鼓槌相互敲了几下。

ex.en: A skilled drummer helps musicians maintain a steady rhythm, which is essential for a coordinated live performance.
ex.zh: 熟练的鼓手帮助乐手保持稳定节奏，这对现场演出的协调至关重要。

col: a skilled drummer｜技艺娴熟的鼓手
tip: drum加-er构成drummer，注意双写m。

senses.en: Unable to think or act normally after drinking alcohol
So excited by something that sensible judgment is lost
Someone who is drunk or frequently drinks too much alcohol

ex.en: He was too drunk to walk home safely.
ex.zh: 他醉得无法安全步行回家。

ex.en: Public awareness campaigns can help reduce accidents caused by drunk drivers, especially among younger adults.
ex.zh: 公众宣传活动有助于减少酒驾造成的事故，尤其是在年轻成年人中。

col: drunk with power｜因权力而忘乎所以
tip: drunk通常作表语；修饰名词也常用drunken。

senses.en: A machine or device that removes moisture from things.

ex.en: The towels are still warm from the dryer.
ex.zh: 毛巾刚从烘干机里拿出来，还是热的。

ex.en: Using a clothesline instead of an electric dryer can lower household energy consumption and reduce monthly bills.
ex.zh: 用晾衣绳代替电烘干机，可以降低家庭能耗并减少每月账单支出。

tip: dryer通常是干燥设备；dry的比较级通常写drier。

senses.en: Required to be paid or submitted by a particular time.
Expected to happen or arrive at a particular time.
Deserved or appropriate in a particular situation.

ex.en: Our rent is due at the end of the week.
ex.zh: 我们的房租本周末到期应付。

ex.en: When tuition fees are due, some students struggle to cover both educational expenses and basic living costs.
ex.zh: 学费到期应缴时，一些学生难以同时承担教育支出和基本生活费用。

tip: be due to do表示预计做；due to＋名词表示由于。

senses.en: Not interesting or exciting.
Not bright or sunny.
Having an edge that does not cut easily.

ex.en: The film was so dull that I nearly fell asleep.
ex.zh: 这部电影太无聊了，我差点睡着。

ex.en: Lessons can seem dull when students have few opportunities to ask questions or explore ideas independently.
ex.zh: 如果学生很少有机会提问或独立探索想法，课堂就可能显得枯燥。

tip: 形容刀刃时指“钝”，形容活动时指“无聊”。

senses.en: Fine, dry particles that settle on surfaces or float.
To remove dust from a surface.
To cover something lightly with a powder.

ex.en: A thick layer of dust covered the old piano.
ex.zh: 那架旧钢琴上积了厚厚一层灰。

ex.en: Construction dust can reduce local air quality and cause breathing difficulties among nearby residents.
ex.zh: 施工扬尘会降低当地空气质量，并导致附近居民呼吸困难。

col: a layer of dust｜一层灰尘
dust the shelves｜掸去架子上的灰
dust with flour｜撒上少量面粉
tip: dust作动词既可指除尘，也可指撒粉，看宾语判断。

senses.en: Covered with dust or containing a lot of dust.

ex.en: I wiped the dusty shelf with a damp cloth.
ex.zh: 我用湿布擦了擦落满灰尘的架子。

ex.en: Workers in dusty environments need appropriate protective equipment to reduce their risk of developing respiratory diseases.
ex.zh: 在多尘环境中工作的人员需要适当的防护装备，以降低患呼吸系统疾病的风险。

col: a dusty road｜尘土飞扬的道路
tip: dusty形容有灰尘；dust作动词可表示掸去灰尘。

senses.en: something you should do because it is right or required
work required by a job or a period of service
a tax charged on certain goods

ex.en: It is my duty to keep these animals safe.
ex.zh: 保护这些动物的安全是我的责任。

ex.en: Governments have a duty to protect vulnerable citizens while ensuring that public services remain financially sustainable.
ex.zh: 政府有责任保护弱势公民，同时确保公共服务在财政上可持续。

tip: on duty指值班；具体岗位职责常用复数duties。

senses.en: Sold without certain taxes, especially to international travellers.
Without paying certain taxes on goods.

ex.en: She bought some duty-free perfume before boarding her flight.
ex.zh: 登机前，她买了一些免税香水。

ex.en: Duty-free shopping can generate substantial revenue for airports, although travellers may not always find the lowest prices.
ex.zh: 免税购物能为机场带来可观收入，但旅客未必总能买到价格最低的商品。

tip: duty此处指关税；免税商品仍受入境额度限制。

senses.en: A large hunting bird with powerful claws and sharp eyesight

ex.en: An eagle circled slowly above the rocky valley.
ex.zh: 一只鹰在岩石遍布的山谷上方缓缓盘旋。

ex.en: Protecting mountain forests helps preserve the hunting grounds and nesting sites of the eagle.
ex.zh: 保护山地森林有助于保全鹰的猎食区和筑巢地。

tip: eagle通常指大型猛禽；eagle-eyed形容眼力敏锐。

senses.en: A small device worn in or over an ear for listening

ex.en: One earphone fell out while I was jogging.
ex.zh: 我慢跑时，一只耳机掉了出来。

ex.en: Students using earphones in shared study spaces can listen to educational recordings without disturbing others.
ex.zh: 学生在公共自习空间使用耳机，可以收听教学录音而不打扰他人。

col: a pair of earphones｜一副耳机
tip: 通常用复数earphones；一副耳机用a pair of。

senses.en: Sudden shaking of the ground caused by movement beneath Earth's surface.

ex.en: The earthquake made the cups rattle on our kitchen shelf.
ex.zh: 地震使厨房架子上的杯子碰得咯咯作响。

ex.en: Strict building regulations can significantly reduce the risk of injury when an earthquake strikes a densely populated city.
ex.zh: 当地震袭击人口稠密的城市时，严格的建筑法规可以显著降低人员受伤的风险。

tip: 可数名词；表示发生地震可说an earthquake strikes。

senses.en: In or relating to the east of an area.

ex.en: Our hotel overlooks the island's quiet eastern coast.
ex.zh: 我们的酒店俯瞰着岛上宁静的东海岸。

ex.en: Improved railway connections could help eastern regions attract investment and reduce economic differences within the country.
ex.zh: 改善铁路连接有助于东部地区吸引投资，缩小国内经济差距。

tip: eastern通常只作形容词，不表示“东方人”。

senses.en: relaxed and not easily upset or worried

ex.en: Our easy-going neighbour never complains when our dog barks.
ex.zh: 我们随和的邻居从不因我们的狗叫而抱怨。

ex.en: Although an easy-going management style can reduce workplace stress, clear expectations remain essential for maintaining productivity.
ex.zh: 虽然随和的管理风格能减轻职场压力，但明确的要求对保持生产力仍然至关重要。

tip: 形容性格随和、不易生气，不表示懒惰。

senses.en: Relating to trade, industry, money, or the study of these.

ex.en: The news discussed economic problems affecting local shops.
ex.zh: 新闻讨论了影响当地商店的经济问题。

ex.en: Investment in public transport can support economic growth by connecting workers with a wider range of jobs.
ex.zh: 投资公共交通能让劳动者获得更广泛的就业机会，从而促进经济增长。

tip: economic指经济方面的；economical指节约的。

senses.en: The study of how societies produce, distribute, and use resources.
The financial factors affecting whether an activity is practical.

ex.en: My sister studies economics and enjoys discussing food prices.
ex.zh: 我姐姐学经济学，喜欢讨论食品价格。

ex.en: Studying economics helps students understand how government policies influence employment, inflation, and the distribution of wealth.
ex.zh: 学习经济学有助于学生理解政府政策如何影响就业、通货膨胀和财富分配。

col: the economics of recycling｜回收利用的经济可行性
tip: 指学科时虽以s结尾，仍接单数谓语。

senses.en: the system of producing, trading, and using goods and services
careful use of money, time, or resources to avoid waste

ex.en: Tourists support the local economy by shopping here.
ex.zh: 游客在这里购物，为当地经济提供支持。

ex.en: Investing in renewable energy can strengthen the economy while reducing dependence on imported fuels.
ex.zh: 投资可再生能源可以增强经济实力，同时减少对进口燃料的依赖。

tip: economic指经济的；economical指节省的、划算的。

senses.en: The outer limit of an object, area, or surface.
A quality that makes someone or something more competitive.
To move slowly and carefully in a particular direction.

ex.en: Keep your glass away from the edge of the table.
ex.zh: 别把你的玻璃杯放在桌子边缘。

ex.en: Practical experience can give graduates an edge over other candidates in a competitive job market.
ex.zh: 在竞争激烈的就业市场中，实践经验能让毕业生比其他求职者更有优势。

col: have an edge over｜比……有优势
tip: 表示优势时常用an edge over，指胜过某人。

senses.en: To improve or prepare writing, images, or recordings by making changes.

ex.en: I need to edit this video before dinner.
ex.zh: 我需要在晚饭前剪辑好这段视频。

ex.en: Students should learn to edit their essays carefully, checking both the structure and the accuracy of their arguments.
ex.zh: 学生应学会仔细修改论文，检查论证的结构与准确性。

tip: edit强调修改或剪辑，publish才是出版或发布。

senses.en: someone who prepares written material or manages a publication
someone who selects and arranges recorded images or sound
software used to change digital content

ex.en: The editor suggested a clearer ending for my story.
ex.zh: 编辑建议我给故事写一个更清楚的结尾。

ex.en: A newspaper editor must balance the public's right to information with respect for individual privacy.
ex.zh: 报纸编辑必须在公众知情权与尊重个人隐私之间取得平衡。

col: editor of a magazine｜杂志编辑
tip: editor可指编辑人员，也可指编辑软件。

senses.en: To teach someone and develop their knowledge or skills.
To give people information about a particular subject.

ex.en: These colourful picture books educate children while keeping them entertained.
ex.zh: 这些色彩鲜艳的图画书寓教于乐，让孩子们学到知识。

ex.en: Public health campaigns should educate people about nutrition rather than simply encourage them to lose weight.
ex.zh: 公共卫生宣传活动应向人们普及营养知识，而不只是鼓励他们减重。

col: educate people about｜向人们普及……知识
tip: educate强调教育培养；teach也可直接接学科。

senses.en: A change or result caused by something.
To bring about a change or result.

ex.en: The new curtains had a calming effect on the room.
ex.zh: 新窗帘让房间的氛围变得宁静了。

ex.en: Higher parking charges may have little effect on traffic unless reliable public transport is also available.
ex.zh: 如果没有可靠的公共交通，提高停车费对交通状况的影响可能很小。

col: have an effect on｜对……有影响
tip: effect常作名词；affect常作动词，意为影响。

senses.en: producing the intended or desired result
officially in force from a particular time
existing in practice, even if not officially recognised

ex.en: This simple stretch is effective at easing shoulder tension.
ex.zh: 这个简单的伸展动作能有效缓解肩部紧绷。

ex.en: Effective environmental policies should combine clear regulations with financial incentives that encourage businesses to reduce waste.
ex.zh: 有效的环境政策应将明确的法规与鼓励企业减少废弃物的经济激励相结合。

col: effective in doing something｜在做某事方面有效
tip: effective强调达到效果；efficient强调省时省力。

senses.en: Working well without wasting time, energy, or resources.

ex.en: Our new washing machine is quieter and more efficient.
ex.zh: 我们的新洗衣机更安静，也更节能。

ex.en: An efficient public transport network allows cities to move more people while consuming less energy.
ex.zh: 高效的公共交通网络使城市能够以更低的能耗运送更多乘客。

col: efficient use of resources｜高效利用资源
tip: efficient强调少浪费；effective强调达到预期效果。

senses.en: physical or mental energy used to achieve something
an attempt or organised activity intended to achieve a goal

ex.en: It took considerable effort to push the sofa upstairs.
ex.zh: 把沙发推上楼费了好大力气。

ex.en: Reducing household waste requires a joint effort from consumers, manufacturers and local authorities to change everyday practices.
ex.zh: 减少家庭垃圾需要消费者、制造商和地方政府共同努力，改变日常做法。

tip: 表示精力时不可数；表示一次尝试时可数。

senses.en: the joint where your arm bends
to push someone or something with your elbow

ex.en: I knocked my elbow against the kitchen door.
ex.zh: 我的胳膊肘撞到了厨房门上。

ex.en: Passengers sometimes elbow their way onto crowded trains, making public transport uncomfortable for others.
ex.zh: 乘客有时用肘推挤着登上拥挤的列车，让其他人乘车时感到不适。

col: rest your elbows on｜将双肘搁在……上
elbow your way through｜用肘推挤着穿过
tip: elbow作动词时常指用肘推挤着前进。

senses.en: a process in which people vote to choose representatives
the act of being chosen for a position by voting

ex.en: Our club is holding an election for its next chair.
ex.zh: 我们俱乐部正在举行选举，选出下一任主席。

ex.en: A fair election requires transparent procedures and equal opportunities for candidates to present their policies.
ex.zh: 公平的选举需要透明的程序，并让候选人有平等机会介绍其政策。

tip: elect强调投票选出；select泛指挑选。

senses.en: Related to electricity or equipment that uses it.

ex.en: An electrical fault left our kitchen in darkness.
ex.zh: 一处电路故障让我们的厨房一片漆黑。

ex.en: Regular inspections of electrical equipment can reduce fire risks in crowded residential buildings and workplaces.
ex.zh: 定期检查电气设备可以降低人口密集的住宅楼和工作场所的火灾风险。

tip: electrical常指电气领域；electric常指电驱动的。

senses.en: Someone trained to install and repair electrical systems.

ex.en: The electrician fixed the broken light in our kitchen.
ex.zh: 电工修好了我们厨房里坏掉的灯。

ex.en: Training more qualified electricians is essential as households increasingly adopt solar panels and electric vehicle charging equipment.
ex.zh: 随着越来越多家庭安装太阳能板和电动汽车充电设备，培养更多合格电工至关重要。

tip: electrician指电工；电气工程师是electrical engineer。

senses.en: using circuits to control electrical signals
stored, sent, or accessed using computers

ex.en: Please switch off your electronic devices during the performance.
ex.zh: 演出期间请关闭电子设备。

ex.en: Electronic health records can help doctors share information efficiently, but strong safeguards are needed to protect patient privacy.
ex.zh: 电子健康档案能帮助医生高效共享信息，但必须采取有力措施保护患者隐私。

tip: electronic强调电子电路；electric泛指用电的。

senses.en: An important or basic part of something.
A substance that cannot be chemically divided into simpler substances.
Strong wind, rain, or other difficult weather conditions.

ex.en: Fresh herbs are a key element of this soup.
ex.zh: 新鲜香草是这道汤的关键配料。

ex.en: Public trust is an essential element of any successful policy aimed at improving community health.
ex.zh: 公众信任是任何旨在改善社区健康的政策取得成功的必要因素。

col: exposure to the elements｜暴露于风雨之中
tip: 表示风雨等自然力量时，通常用the elements。

senses.en: Related to the simplest or first stages of learning.
Relating to the first years of formal school education.

ex.en: This course teaches elementary cooking skills to complete beginners.
ex.zh: 这门课程向零基础学员教授基本烹饪技巧。

ex.en: Elementary education should develop children's curiosity as well as their ability to read and calculate.
ex.zh: 小学教育不仅应培养儿童的阅读和计算能力，还应激发他们的好奇心。

tip: elementary school主要用于美式英语，英式常用primary school。

senses.en: To make someone feel awkward, ashamed, or uncomfortable.

ex.en: Please don't embarrass me by sharing that childhood photo.
ex.zh: 请别把那张童年照片给别人看，让我难为情。

ex.en: Correcting every mistake publicly can embarrass language learners and discourage them from participating in classroom discussions.
ex.zh: 公开纠正每一个错误会让语言学习者感到尴尬，并使他们不愿参与课堂讨论。

tip: 人感到尴尬用embarrassed；事情令人尴尬用embarrassing。

senses.en: Feeling uncomfortable or ashamed about something others notice.

ex.en: I felt embarrassed when my phone rang during dinner.
ex.zh: 吃饭时手机响了，我感到很尴尬。

ex.en: Students may feel embarrassed about making mistakes, so teachers should create a supportive classroom environment.
ex.zh: 学生可能因犯错而感到难为情，因此教师应营造支持性的课堂环境。

col: too embarrassed to ask｜难为情而不敢问
tip: 人感到尴尬用embarrassed；事令人尴尬用embarrassing。

senses.zh: 令人尴尬的；使人难堪的
senses.en: Making someone feel awkward, ashamed, or uncomfortable

ex.en: It was embarrassing when my phone rang during the ceremony.
ex.zh: 典礼进行时我的手机响了，真让人尴尬。

ex.en: Students may avoid asking questions if they believe that making mistakes in front of classmates is embarrassing.
ex.zh: 如果学生觉得在同学面前犯错很丢脸，他们可能会避免提问。

col: an embarrassing mistake｜令人尴尬的错误
an embarrassing situation｜令人难堪的处境
tip: 事物令人尴尬用embarrassing；人感到尴尬用embarrassed。

senses.en: A serious, unexpected situation requiring immediate action.

ex.en: Keep a torch nearby in case of an emergency.
ex.zh: 在手边备好手电筒，以防出现紧急情况。

ex.en: Governments should invest in emergency services to ensure that communities receive rapid assistance during natural disasters.
ex.zh: 政府应投资应急服务，确保社区在自然灾害期间迅速获得援助。

col: in an emergency｜在紧急情况下
a state of emergency｜紧急状态
tip: 是可数名词；emergency exit中的名词作定语。

senses.en: Related to feelings rather than thoughts or physical needs.
Showing or experiencing strong feelings.

ex.en: Her friends gave her emotional support during the move.
ex.zh: 搬家期间，她的朋友们在情感上给予了她支持。

ex.en: Schools should support children's emotional development alongside academic progress to promote their long-term well-being.
ex.zh: 学校应在促进学业进步的同时支持儿童的情感发展，以增进他们的长期福祉。

tip: emotional不一定指悲伤，也可指喜悦等强烈情绪。

senses.en: Pay someone to work for you.
Use a method, skill, or resource for a purpose.

ex.en: The bakery employs three people from our neighbourhood.
ex.zh: 这家面包店雇用了我们街区的三个人。

ex.en: Teachers can employ a range of practical activities to help students understand complex scientific concepts.
ex.zh: 教师可以采用一系列实践活动，帮助学生理解复杂的科学概念。

col: employ someone as｜雇用某人担任
tip: employ既可指雇人，也可正式地表示采用方法。

senses.en: A person or organisation that pays people to work.

ex.en: My employer lets me work from home on Fridays.
ex.zh: 我的雇主允许我每周五在家办公。

ex.en: Employers can improve staff retention by offering fair wages, flexible schedules, and opportunities for professional development.
ex.zh: 雇主可以通过提供公平的薪资、灵活的工作安排和职业发展机会来提高员工留任率。

col: a major employer｜大型用人单位
tip: employer是雇主；employee是雇员。

senses.en: paid work or the state of having a paid job
the use of something for a particular purpose

ex.en: She found employment at a bakery near her home.
ex.zh: 她在家附近的一家面包店找到了工作。

ex.en: Investment in renewable energy can create employment opportunities while helping countries meet their climate targets.
ex.zh: 投资可再生能源可以创造就业机会，同时帮助各国实现气候目标。

tip: 通常不可数；一份工作用a job，不用an employment。

senses.en: Give someone confidence or support to do something
Make an activity or development more likely

ex.en: My sister encouraged me to join the swimming club.
ex.zh: 姐姐鼓励我加入游泳俱乐部。

ex.en: Local governments can encourage cycling by providing safer routes and secure bicycle parking near workplaces.
ex.zh: 地方政府可以通过提供更安全的路线和工作场所附近的安全自行车停车设施来鼓励骑行。

col: encourage someone to do something｜鼓励某人做某事
tip: 用encourage sb to do sth表示鼓励某人做某事。

senses.en: Having formally agreed to marry someone.
Actively involved in an activity or task.
Currently being used and therefore unavailable.

ex.en: My sister got engaged during her holiday by the sea.
ex.zh: 我姐姐在海边度假时订婚了。

ex.en: Students who are actively engaged in classroom discussions often develop stronger communication and critical thinking skills.
ex.zh: 积极参与课堂讨论的学生往往能培养更强的沟通和批判性思维能力。

col: the line is engaged｜电话占线
tip: 订婚对象前用to；参与的活动前用in。

senses.en: using science to design and build machines, structures, or systems

ex.en: My cousin studies engineering and builds small robots at home.
ex.zh: 我的表哥学工程，平时在家制作小型机器人。

ex.en: Advances in engineering have enabled cities to build bridges that withstand extreme weather and carry heavier traffic.
ex.zh: 工程技术的进步使城市能够建造抵御极端天气、承载更大交通量的桥梁。

tip: 表示学科或技术领域时不可数；engineer可指工程师。

senses.en: Giving pleasure or making you feel happy

ex.en: The cooking class was enjoyable, especially making fresh pasta.
ex.zh: 这堂烹饪课很有趣，尤其是制作新鲜意面的时候。

ex.en: Making physical activity enjoyable can encourage children to develop healthy habits that continue into adulthood.
ex.zh: 让体育活动充满乐趣，可以鼓励儿童养成延续至成年的健康习惯。

tip: 形容活动令人愉快用 enjoyable，不用 enjoyed。

senses.en: The pleasure you get from doing or experiencing something

ex.en: My grandfather gets great enjoyment from feeding the birds.
ex.zh: 我祖父从喂鸟中获得了很大的乐趣。

ex.en: Schools should encourage reading for enjoyment rather than focusing exclusively on examination performance.
ex.zh: 学校应鼓励学生享受阅读的乐趣，而不是只关注考试成绩。

col: get enjoyment from｜从……中获得乐趣
tip: 通常不可数；表示从某事获得乐趣可用get enjoyment from。

senses.en: extremely large in size, amount, or degree

ex.en: An enormous pumpkin filled the basket on our kitchen table.
ex.zh: 一个巨大的南瓜占满了厨房桌上的篮子。

ex.en: Rapid urban growth places enormous pressure on housing, transport networks, and other essential public services.
ex.zh: 城市的快速发展给住房、交通网络及其他基本公共服务带来巨大压力。

tip: 既可形容体积，也可形容压力、数量或影响很大。

senses.en: to keep someone interested or amused
to welcome guests and provide food, drink, or activities
to consider an idea or hold a thought or feeling

ex.en: My brother entertained the children with funny animal noises.
ex.zh: 我哥哥模仿动物发出滑稽的叫声，逗孩子们开心。

ex.en: Public museums should educate visitors as well as entertain them through engaging displays and interactive activities.
ex.zh: 公共博物馆应通过引人入胜的展览和互动活动，让参观者既获得知识又享受乐趣。

col: entertain an audience｜为观众提供娱乐
entertain the idea of｜考虑……的想法
tip: entertain an idea指考虑某想法，并非已经接受。

senses.en: Performances or activities that people enjoy watching or doing.

ex.en: The hotel provides live entertainment beside the pool every evening.
ex.zh: 酒店每晚都在泳池边提供现场娱乐表演。

ex.en: Affordable entertainment facilities can improve urban life by giving residents opportunities to relax and socialise.
ex.zh: 价格亲民的娱乐设施能让居民有机会放松和社交，从而改善城市生活。

col: a form of entertainment｜一种娱乐形式
tip: 通常不可数：提供娱乐用provide entertainment。

senses.en: The act of entering, or permission to enter a place.
An individual item in a list, diary, or reference work.
A work or person submitted for a competition.

ex.en: Entry to the swimming pool is free today.
ex.zh: 今天进入游泳池免费。

ex.en: Strict entry requirements may prevent capable students from disadvantaged backgrounds from accessing higher education opportunities.
ex.zh: 严格的入学要求可能使来自弱势背景的优秀学生无法获得高等教育机会。

col: entry requirements｜入学要求；准入条件
tip: 进入某处常用entry to；具体入口通常用entrance。

senses.en: relating to nature or efforts to protect it
relating to the surroundings in which people or organisms live

ex.en: Our school organised an environmental project to clean the river.
ex.zh: 我们学校组织了一项清理河流的环保活动。

ex.en: Governments should consider the environmental impact of new roads before approving major construction projects.
ex.zh: 政府在批准大型建设项目之前，应考虑新道路对环境的影响。

tip: environmental是形容词，环境本身用environment。

senses.en: one part of a television or radio series
a particular event or period within a longer story
a period when someone experiences a particular illness or symptom

ex.en: We watched the final episode together after dinner.
ex.zh: 晚饭后，我们一起看了最后一集。

ex.en: Each episode of the documentary explores how urban development affects wildlife in different parts of the world.
ex.zh: 这部纪录片每一集都探讨城市发展如何影响世界不同地区的野生动物。

col: a brief episode｜一段短暂经历
tip: episode指一集；series指整部系列或连续剧。

senses.en: The same in amount, value, status, or opportunity.
To be the same in quantity, value, or quality.
Someone with the same status, ability, or rights as another.

ex.en: We divided the cake into equal pieces for everyone.
ex.zh: 我们把蛋糕切成大小相等的小块，分给大家。

ex.en: Governments should ensure that children from all backgrounds have equal access to quality education and essential healthcare.
ex.zh: 政府应确保各种背景的儿童都能平等地获得优质教育和基本医疗服务。

col: treat as an equal｜平等对待
tip: 形容词常接to；动词equal直接接宾语，不加to。

senses.en: An imaginary line around Earth's middle, equally distant from both poles.

ex.en: Our guide explained why it stays warm near the equator.
ex.zh: 导游解释了为什么赤道附近一直很暖和。

ex.en: Regions near the equator receive intense sunlight throughout the year, contributing to consistently high temperatures.
ex.zh: 赤道附近的地区全年受到强烈的阳光照射，因此气温持续偏高。

col: north of the equator｜赤道以北
tip: 赤道前通常加the；形容词是equatorial。

senses.en: something incorrect in an action, calculation, or judgement
the difference between a measured value and the true value

ex.en: An error in the booking left us without seats.
ex.zh: 预订出了差错，导致我们没有座位。

ex.en: Researchers should check their calculations carefully, as a minor error can significantly affect the final conclusions.
ex.zh: 研究人员应仔细核查计算过程，因为一个小错误就可能显著影响最终结论。

col: a margin of error｜误差范围
tip: error比mistake正式，常用于技术、计算或判断。

senses.en: moving stairs that carry people between floors

ex.en: Hold the handrail while you ride the escalator upstairs.
ex.zh: 乘自动扶梯上楼时，请扶好扶手。

ex.en: Although escalators improve passenger flow in stations, lifts are essential for travellers who use wheelchairs.
ex.zh: 尽管自动扶梯能改善车站的客流通行情况，但对使用轮椅的旅客而言，电梯必不可少。

col: an upward escalator｜上行自动扶梯
tip: escalator是自动扶梯；lift是厢式电梯。

senses.en: to get away from confinement or a dangerous situation
to avoid something unpleasant or harmful
the act of getting free from danger or unpleasant conditions

ex.en: Our rabbit escaped through a small gap in the fence.
ex.zh: 我们的兔子从围栏的一处小缝隙逃走了。

ex.en: Accessible parks offer urban residents an escape from crowded streets and opportunities to enjoy nature.
ex.zh: 便利可达的公园让城市居民得以远离拥挤的街道，并有机会亲近自然。

tip: 逃离某处用escape from；免遭某事可直接接名词。

senses.en: Completely necessary for a particular purpose or situation
Relating to the most important characteristics of something
A necessary item or basic fact, usually mentioned in plural

ex.en: A warm coat is essential for this winter walk.
ex.zh: 这次冬日散步必须穿一件暖和的外套。

ex.en: Access to clean drinking water is essential for preventing disease and improving public health.
ex.zh: 获得清洁饮用水对预防疾病和改善公共卫生至关重要。

col: essential for survival｜生存所必需的
tip: 名词常用复数 essentials，表示必需品或基本要点。

senses.en: in the end, especially after a long time or difficulty

ex.en: After searching every room, we eventually found the missing keys.
ex.zh: 搜遍每个房间后，我们终于找到了丢失的钥匙。

ex.en: Investment in public transport may initially be expensive, but it can eventually reduce congestion and improve urban life.
ex.zh: 公共交通投资起初可能成本高昂，但最终能够缓解拥堵并改善城市生活。

tip: 强调经过时间或困难后的结果，不表示可能。

senses.en: a formal test of knowledge or ability
the act of looking at something carefully to assess it

ex.en: She felt relieved when her final examination was over.
ex.zh: 最后一场考试结束后，她松了一口气。

ex.en: A detailed examination of local housing conditions can help governments identify communities that need urgent support.
ex.zh: 对当地住房条件进行详细调查，可以帮助政府找出急需援助的社区。

tip: 考试义口语常简称exam；检查义常接of。

senses.en: to give something and receive something else in return
an act of giving and receiving things, information, or ideas
a market where shares, currencies, or goods are traded

ex.en: Can I exchange this shirt for a smaller size?
ex.zh: 我能把这件衬衫换成小一号的吗？

ex.en: International exchange programmes allow students to experience different cultures and develop greater confidence in communicating.
ex.zh: 国际交流项目让学生体验不同文化，并增强他们沟通时的信心。

tip: exchange A for B表示用A换B，注意介词for。

senses.en: to make someone feel enthusiastic and eager
to cause a particular feeling or reaction

ex.en: Trips to the seaside always excite my younger sister.
ex.zh: 去海边玩总能让我妹妹兴奋不已。

ex.en: Interactive science exhibitions can excite young visitors and encourage them to explore scientific ideas independently.
ex.zh: 互动式科学展览能让年轻参观者兴奋起来，并鼓励他们自主探索科学概念。

tip: 人感到兴奋用excited；事物令人兴奋用exciting。

senses.en: a feeling of great enthusiasm and eager anticipation
something that creates strong interest or enthusiasm

ex.en: The children jumped with excitement when the puppies arrived.
ex.zh: 小狗到来时，孩子们兴奋得跳了起来。

ex.en: Although international sporting events generate excitement, host cities must carefully assess their long-term financial costs.
ex.zh: 虽然国际体育赛事令人振奋，但主办城市必须仔细评估其长期财务成本。

col: contain your excitement｜抑制兴奋之情
tip: 表示兴奋情绪通常不可数：with excitement。

senses.en: extremely tired and lacking energy
completely used up, with nothing remaining

ex.en: After carrying those boxes upstairs, I felt completely exhausted.
ex.zh: 把那些箱子搬上楼后，我感到筋疲力尽。

ex.en: Employees who are constantly exhausted may struggle to concentrate, increasing the risk of mistakes at work.
ex.zh: 长期疲惫不堪的员工可能难以集中注意力，从而增加工作中出错的风险。

tip: 人感到累用exhausted；事情令人累用exhausting。
